name: JADI
recent: Jadi Imaging 于 2026 年 11 月 16 日召开特别股东大会，通过削减 RM40.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。此前公司于 9 月完成第 25 届常年股东大会，并有多项凭单行使导致新股上市。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比和同比均大幅下降。
notable: 特别股东大会通过削减 RM40.00 million 已发行股本的特别决议。
第 25 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 22 日举行，所有决议获通过，但 Tan Su Ning 撤回连任董事的意愿。
多批凭单行使（共约 507,157 股）后新股上市，发行价每股 RM0.05。
risks: 股本削减涉及 RM40.00 million，可能影响每股账面价值及股东权益结构。
最新季度营收环比下降 49.5%、同比下降 80.0%，业务规模显著收缩。
Tan Su Ning 同时卸任董事、审计委员会及薪酬委员会职务，管理层出现变动。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM269,000，环比下降 49.5%，同比下降 80.0%；净利为 RM298,000，净利率 110.8%，较上季度的 -179.4% 转正。

recent_en: Jadi Imaging held an EGM on 16 Nov 2026 and passed a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM40.00 million. The company also completed its 25th AGM in September, with several warrant exercises leading to new share listings. Latest quarterly revenue (ended 30 June 2026) fell sharply both QoQ and YoY.
notable_en: EGM passed a special resolution to reduce issued share capital by RM40.00 million.
25th AGM held on 22 Sep 2026; all resolutions passed, but Tan Su Ning withdrew her intention to seek re-election as Director.
New shares listed following several warrant exercises (totaling approximately 507,157 shares) at an issue price of RM0.05 per share.
risks_en: The RM40.00 million capital reduction may affect book value per share and shareholders' equity structure.
Latest quarterly revenue fell 49.5% QoQ and 80.0% YoY, indicating significant business contraction.
Tan Su Ning stepped down from the Board, Audit Committee and Remuneration Committee, resulting in management changes.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM269,000, down 49.5% QoQ and 80.0% YoY; net income was RM298,000 with a net margin of 110.8%, turning positive from -179.4% in the previous quarter.
